audit.whatIsWrong: Stored chart is Skill / Olaf / Olaf / Skill / Skill / Olaf / Olaf in both layers. The mirror records 'Olaf Levels 1-3; Skill at 4-5, 6 and first item; Wukong at two-plus items', which is packet.levelChart exactly. Rows 0, 5 and 6 disagree.
audit.why: This page's own whys already state the mirror's version: whys[0] 'Level 1 favors Olaf', whys[5] 'keeping the lane even', whys[6] 'favoring you'. Three rows were rendering a different winner from the sentence underneath them.
audit.corrected: Flipped row 0 to Olaf, row 5 to Skill and row 6 to Wukong in BOTH layers as one atomic paired group, ratings moved with them (4/10, 5/10, 6/10).

audit.whatIsWrong: Ragnarok is described only as CC immunity. Two parts are missing: it also grants PASSIVE bonus armor and magic resist even while unused, and the active immunity holds only 'for as long as he keeps attacking'.
audit.why: Both change when you fight him. The passive resists mean his level 6 spike exists whether or not he presses R, and the attack-to-sustain rule means the immunity is not a fixed duration you wait out — it ends when he has nothing to hit, which is exactly what your clone and a wall of minions can arrange.
audit.corrected: Wrote the passive resists and the keep-attacking condition into the level 6 spike, with Ragnarok's real 100/90/80s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two hard errors and one absence. (a) 'W Vicious Strikes lifesteal' — Vicious Strikes is not in this kit. His W is TOUGH IT OUT: attack speed plus a SHIELD, 700 range, 16/15/14/13/12s. The life steal is the PASSIVE, Berserker Rage, which scales with his MISSING health. (b) The same wrong attribution repeats in spikes[2] ('disengage his lifesteal windows'), early and wants.foe[1]. (c) Reckless Swing (E) does not appear anywhere on the page at all, despite dealing TRUE DAMAGE at 325 range on 11/10/9/8/7s, costing Olaf health that is refunded if it kills.
audit.why: The two mistakes point the player the wrong way at once. Believing the sustain is on a 16-second W teaches 'trade after he uses it'; the truth is the opposite — his healing gets STRONGER the lower he goes, so a long brawl with a low Olaf is the worst possible fight and Executioner's Calling is the answer, not patience. And Reckless Swing being true damage means Plated Steelcaps and armor stacking do nothing against his biggest single hit; a Wukong reading this page has no idea that damage exists.
audit.corrected: Reassigned the shield and attack speed to Tough It Out and the life steal to Berserker Rage with the missing-health scaling, and put Reckless Swing's true damage, 325 range and 11s rank-1 cooldown into the spikes and the cooldown breakdown. Also gave Undertow its real 1000 range, flat 9s cooldown, ARMOR reduction (not just a slow) and the pick-up reset.
sources: enemyKit P/Q/W/E text, ranges and cooldowns

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] is headed 'Get axe-slowed' but its body is unrelated boilerplate, and no cooldown number appears anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Undertow's flat 9 seconds — and the fact that he refunds it entirely by walking over the axe — is the single most punishable thing about him, and it was not written down.
audit.corrected: Undertow's 9s and its pick-up reset written into the don'ts, the do's, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t.

audit.why: The early Executioner's Calling line is right, and now for a stated reason: Berserker Rage's life steal ramps as his health falls, so Grievous Wounds matters most in exactly the brawl the page warns against.

edits.after: Black Cleaver lands, but so does his item — an even window, taken on Ragnarok's cooldown.

edits.after: Olaf owns the early game — Undertow slows AND cuts your armor from 1000 range, and his passive heals him harder the lower he drops. Walking over the axe refunds its whole 9-second cooldown.

edits.after: Around first item things even out: your spike plus the Warrior Trickster decoy dodges his axe and breaks off before his healing ramps. Reckless Swing is TRUE damage on 11s, so armor will not save you.

edits.before: Olaf out-trades you at every early level — Q slows and pokes while W lifesteal heals through your Q Crushing Blow.
edits.after: Olaf out-trades you early — Undertow slows and shreds armor while Berserker Rage heals him more the lower he gets.

edits.before: Sustain through trades with W lifesteal

edits.after: - Olaf Ragnarok: matchup-defining — disable-immune while he keeps attacking, 100s at rank 1. Bait it. - Reckless Swing: true damage at 325 range, 11s at rank 1 — armor does not reduce it. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

notes: The 'W Vicious Strikes lifesteal' line is the important kill here: Vicious Strikes is not an ability in this kit, the W (Tough It Out) is attack speed plus a shield, and the life steal belongs to the passive and gets STRONGER as his health drops. The page was teaching a player to grind out a long trade against a low Olaf, which is the fight he is built to win. Reckless Swing's true damage was absent from every field and is why Plated Steelcaps alone is not an answer — a human may want to revisit report[8].t's boots line in light of it. Not asserted because the data cannot settle it: whether Cyclone's knockup can displace him before Ragnarok is active, whether Ragnarok's immunity can be pre-empted or is QSS-able from your side, and how long the 'keeps attacking' grace period actually lasts. Note packet.games is 271 while the brief header says 1494 — a human should reconcile which figure the page shows.
